component_models: AMD Ryzen 5 9600X, MSI B850 Edge WiFi
evidence_summary: Ryzen 5 9600X (AM5) and MSI B850 Edge WiFi (AM5) share the physical AM5 LGA1718 socket. B850 chipset launched with native AGESA support for Ryzen 9000 Zen 5 architecture out-of-the-box.
conditions_or_conflicts: None; native launch BIOS supports Ryzen 9000.

component_models: AMD Ryzen 5 9600X, MSI MAG B650 Tomahawk WiFi
evidence_summary: Both specify AM5 socket and B650 chipset is officially supported. However, B650 launched in 2022 while 9600X launched in August 2024. Requires BIOS version 7D75v1J (AGESA 1.2.0.0a) or newer.
conditions_or_conflicts: Requires BIOS update if board has older factory firmware. Board supports Flash BIOS Button (USB flashback without older CPU).

component_models: AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D, MSI MAG B650 Tomahawk WiFi
evidence_summary: AM5 socket match. 7800X3D launched April 2023; boards manufactured before March 2023 require BIOS 7D75v14 or newer for X3D microcode and SOC voltage protections.
conditions_or_conflicts: Older inventory boards require BIOS update; USB Flash BIOS button available.

component_models: AMD Ryzen 7 5700X3D, Gigabyte B550 EAGLE WIFI6
evidence_summary: Both specify AM4 socket and B550 chipset. 5700X3D launched January 2024 and requires BIOS revision F16 or newer on Gigabyte B550 motherboards.
conditions_or_conflicts: Requires BIOS update to F16+ to POST if shipped with earlier factory BIOS. Gigabyte Q-Flash Plus supported.

component_models: AMD Ryzen 5 9600X, MSI PRO H610M-G DDR4
evidence_summary: AMD AM5 processor (LGA1718 pinout, 40x40mm package) is physically and electrically incompatible with Intel LGA1700 socket (37.5x45mm package).
conditions_or_conflicts: Blocking hardware conflict: socket and chipset mismatch.

component_models: Intel Core Ultra 9 285K, MSI MAG Z890 Tomahawk WiFi
evidence_summary: Core Ultra 9 285K (Arrow Lake) uses the LGA1851 socket, which is natively supported by the Intel Z890 chipset on the MSI Z890 Tomahawk.
conditions_or_conflicts: None; native launch support.

component_models: Intel Core Ultra 9 285K, ASUS ROG MAXIMUS Z790 HERO
evidence_summary: Core Ultra 9 285K requires LGA1851 socket. ASUS Z790 HERO features an LGA1700 socket. Pin count and contact pad layout differ; CPU cannot be installed.
conditions_or_conflicts: Blocking hardware conflict: LGA1851 vs LGA1700 socket mismatch.

component_models: Intel Core i9-14900K, MSI PRO H610M-G DDR4
evidence_summary: Physically fits LGA1700 socket and supported with BIOS update. However, H610 budget 4+1 phase unheatsinked VRM cannot sustain the 253W+ PL2 of the 14900K, resulting in extreme VRM thermal throttling down to ~65W-95W.
conditions_or_conflicts: Severely degraded multi-threaded performance due to motherboard VRM current/thermal limits. Not recommended for production builds.

component_models: Intel Core i9-12900K, MSI PRO H610M-G DDR4
evidence_summary: 12th Gen Alder Lake i9-12900K and H610 share the LGA1700 socket and Alder Lake is natively supported from release BIOS v1.0. (VRM throttling applies at sustained load).
conditions_or_conflicts: None for boot/POST; sustained multi-core workloads throttled by budget VRM.

component_models: AMD Ryzen 9 5900X, MSI B850 Edge WiFi
evidence_summary: Ryzen 9 5900X is an AM4 PGA processor with 1331 pins. MSI B850 Edge is an AM5 LGA socket with 1718 contact pads. Pin and socket architectures are incompatible.
conditions_or_conflicts: Blocking hardware conflict: AM4 vs AM5 socket mismatch.

component_models: AMD Ryzen 5 9600X, MSI MAG B650 Tomahawk WiFi, G.Skill Trident Z5 Neo 32GB (2x16GB) DDR5-6000 CL30
evidence_summary: Zen 5 CPU, B650 motherboard, and G.Skill RAM kit all use DDR5. DDR5-6000 CL30 with AMD EXPO profile is validated for 1:1 UCLK:MCLK operation on AM5 platforms.
conditions_or_conflicts: EXPO must be enabled in BIOS. Populated in primary slots A2/B2.

component_models: AMD Ryzen 5 9600X, MSI MAG B650 Tomahawk WiFi, Corsair Vengeance LPX 16GB (2x8GB) DDR4-3200
evidence_summary: Ryzen 9600X CPU and B650 motherboard strictly require DDR5 SDRAM. Corsair Vengeance LPX is a DDR4 module with different key notch position (pin pitch 0.85mm vs 1.2mm) and different supply voltage (1.1V vs 1.2V).
conditions_or_conflicts: Blocking hardware conflict: DDR5 motherboard/CPU cannot accept DDR4 DIMM.

component_models: AMD Ryzen 7 5700X3D, Gigabyte B550 EAGLE WIFI6, Corsair Vengeance LPX 16GB (2x8GB) DDR4-3200
evidence_summary: AM4 CPU, B550 motherboard, and RAM kit all specify DDR4 SDRAM. DDR4-3200 is native JEDEC specification for Zen 3 memory controller.
conditions_or_conflicts: Install in DIMM slots A2/B2 for optimal dual-channel signal integrity.

component_models: Intel Core i9-13900K, MSI PRO H610M-G DDR4, Corsair Vengeance LPX 16GB (2x8GB) DDR4-3200
evidence_summary: Intel 13th Gen IMC supports both DDR4 and DDR5. MSI PRO H610M-G DDR4 specifically routes DDR4 memory traces, matching the Corsair DDR4-3200 kit.
conditions_or_conflicts: None; DDR4 matching verified.

component_models: Intel Core i9-13900K, MSI PRO H610M-G DDR4, G.Skill Trident Z5 Neo 32GB DDR5-6000
evidence_summary: Although the i9-13900K IMC supports DDR5, this specific motherboard (MSI PRO H610M-G DDR4) is physically built with DDR4 DIMM slots. DDR5 modules cannot physically fit into DDR4 slots.
conditions_or_conflicts: Blocking hardware conflict: motherboard DIMM slot standard mismatch.

component_models: Intel Core Ultra 9 285K, MSI MAG Z890 Tomahawk WiFi, Corsair Vengeance LPX DDR4-3200
evidence_summary: Intel Arrow Lake-S (Core Ultra 200S) memory controller dropped DDR4 support entirely and supports only DDR5 / CUDIMM. Z890 motherboards only feature DDR5 slots.
conditions_or_conflicts: Blocking hardware conflict: Arrow Lake and Z890 are DDR5-only.

component_models: MSI MAG B650 Tomahawk WiFi, Corsair Vengeance RGB 192GB (4x48GB) DDR5
evidence_summary: MSI B650 Tomahawk supports up to 192GB DDR5 using 48GB non-binary DIMMs across 4 slots with modern AGESA BIOS. However, running 4 dual-rank DIMMs at high speed requires downclocking (typically DDR5-3600 to DDR5-4400) for stability.
conditions_or_conflicts: Requires BIOS update with 24GB/48GB non-binary DIMM support; memory speed must be reduced to JEDEC 4-DIMM baseline for stable operation.

component_models: MSI PRO H610M-G DDR4, Corsair Vengeance RGB 192GB (4x48GB) DDR5
evidence_summary: MSI PRO H610M-G DDR4 has only 2 DIMM slots and max capacity of 64GB DDR4. Corsair 192GB kit has 4 modules of DDR5. Exceeds capacity, exceeds slot count, and mismatches DDR generation.
conditions_or_conflicts: Blocking hardware conflict: DDR type, module count, and capacity all exceed limits.

component_models: MSI MAG B650 Tomahawk WiFi (ATX), NZXT H7 Flow (2024)
evidence_summary: MSI B650 Tomahawk is standard ATX (305 x 244 mm). NZXT H7 Flow chassis supports ATX, micro-ATX, and mini-ITX motherboards with standard standoff locations.
conditions_or_conflicts: None; standard ATX alignment.

component_models: MSI MAG B650 Tomahawk WiFi (ATX), Fractal Pop Air Mini (mATX)
evidence_summary: Standard ATX motherboard (305mm vertical height) cannot physically fit into Fractal Pop Air Mini chassis, which is limited to micro-ATX (max 244mm height) and mini-ITX.
conditions_or_conflicts: Blocking hardware conflict: ATX board cannot fit mATX case.

component_models: MSI PRO H610M-G DDR4 (mATX), Fractal Pop Air Mini (mATX)
evidence_summary: Micro-ATX motherboard (244 x 211 mm) matches Fractal Pop Air Mini chassis designed specifically for micro-ATX and mini-ITX boards.
conditions_or_conflicts: None; exact form factor match.

component_models: ASUS ROG Crosshair X870E Hero (ATX), Lian Li O11 Dynamic EVO XL
evidence_summary: ATX motherboard fits comfortably inside Lian Li O11 EVO XL full tower chassis, which accommodates up to E-ATX boards.
conditions_or_conflicts: None; full tower clearance.

component_models: ASUS ROG Astral RTX 5090 32GB GDDR7 OC (358mm), NZXT H7 Flow (2024)
evidence_summary: ASUS ROG Astral RTX 5090 length is 358mm. NZXT H7 Flow provides maximum GPU clearance of 410mm, leaving 52mm of clearance for airflow.
conditions_or_conflicts: If front push-pull radiator is installed, clearance drops by ~55mm, leaving <5mm clearance.

component_models: ASUS ROG Astral RTX 5090 32GB GDDR7 OC (358mm), Fractal Meshify 2 Compact
evidence_summary: GPU card length is 358mm. Fractal Meshify 2 Compact maximum GPU clearance is 341mm (with front fan). GPU exceeds case clearance by 17mm and cannot physically fit.
conditions_or_conflicts: Blocking physical clearance conflict.

component_models: ASUS ROG Strix GeForce RTX 4090 24GB (357.6mm), Fractal Pop Air Mini
evidence_summary: GPU length is 357.6mm. Pop Air Mini documents 365mm maximum GPU length with standard front fan. Clearance margin is only 7.4mm.
conditions_or_conflicts: Requires standard front fan; any front-mounted AIO liquid cooler radiator will prevent installation (reduces clearance to ~335mm).

component_models: XFX Speedster SWFT 210 Radeon RX 6600 8GB (241mm), Fractal Pop Air Mini
evidence_summary: GPU length is 241mm, well within the 365mm clearance limit of Fractal Pop Air Mini.
conditions_or_conflicts: None; generous 124mm clearance.

component_models: XFX Speedster QICK 319 Core RX 6750 XT 12GB (323mm), Corsair FRAME 4000D RS ARGB
evidence_summary: GPU length is 323mm. Corsair Frame 4000D chassis accommodates graphics cards up to 430mm.
conditions_or_conflicts: None; 107mm clearance.

component_models: DeepCool AK400 Black (155mm), AMD Ryzen 5 9600X (65W AM5), NZXT H7 Flow (185mm)
evidence_summary: DeepCool AK400 supports AM5 socket natively, height of 155mm is within NZXT H7 Flow 185mm cooler clearance, and 220W dissipation rating easily cools the 65W/88W PPT Ryzen 5 9600X.
conditions_or_conflicts: None.

component_models: Cooler Master Hyper 212 Black (152mm), AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D (120W AM5), Fractal Pop Air Mini (165mm)
evidence_summary: Cooler Master Hyper 212 Black supports AM5 socket, 152mm height fits within Fractal Pop Air Mini 165mm clearance, and single tower cooler handles 7800X3D gaming thermal loads (typical draw ~50W-75W in gaming).
conditions_or_conflicts: Under sustained 100% AVX-512 all-core rendering, temperatures will reach 80C-85C due to thick 3D V-Cache thermal density.

component_models: Thermalright Peerless Assassin 120 SE (155mm), AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D (120W AM5), NZXT H7 Flow (185mm)
evidence_summary: Thermalright PA120 SE dual-tower 6-heatpipe air cooler features native AM5 mounting brackets. 155mm height fits within 185mm clearance, and dual 120mm fans provide thermal capacity exceeding 240W, ideal for the 9800X3D.
conditions_or_conflicts: Front fan may need to be stepped up 2-4mm if tall RGB RAM heatspreaders (>38mm) are used.

component_models: Noctua NH-L9x65 chromax.black (65mm), Intel Core i9-14900K (253W LGA1700), NZXT H7 Flow
evidence_summary: While Noctua NH-L9x65 includes LGA1700 mounting brackets and fits inside the case, Noctua's official CPU compatibility database explicitly rates this 65mm low-profile cooler as incapable of dissipating the 253W-300W PL2 load of the Core i9-14900K, causing thermal throttling to ~90W-125W and severe performance loss.
conditions_or_conflicts: Blocking thermal inadequacy conflict; cooler cannot maintain safe operating temperatures under rated CPU power envelopes.

component_models: WD Black SN850X 2TB (M.2 2280 NVMe Gen4), MSI MAG B650 Tomahawk WiFi
evidence_summary: WD Black SN850X is an M.2 2280 PCIe 4.0 x4 NVMe SSD. MSI B650 Tomahawk provides primary M.2 slot directly wired to CPU lanes supporting PCIe 4.0 x4 M.2 2280 drives with integrated M.2 Shield Frozr heatsink.
conditions_or_conflicts: None; full 7300 MB/s sequential read speed supported.

component_models: Crucial T705 2TB (M.2 2280 NVMe Gen5), ASUS ROG Crosshair X870E Hero
evidence_summary: Crucial T705 PCIe 5.0 x4 NVMe SSD matches the primary M.2_1 slot of the ASUS ROG Crosshair X870E Hero, which provides native PCIe 5.0 x4 CPU lane routing supporting up to 14,500 MB/s bandwidth.
conditions_or_conflicts: Gen5 SSD runs hot (>70C); requires motherboard heavy M.2 heatsink to avoid thermal throttling.

component_models: Crucial T705 2TB (M.2 2280 NVMe Gen5), Gigabyte B550 EAGLE WIFI6
evidence_summary: PCIe specifications mandate backwards compatibility. The PCIe 5.0 x4 Crucial T705 will physically install and function in the PCIe 4.0 x4 primary M.2 slot of the Gigabyte B550 EAGLE, but throughput is capped at PCIe 4.0 bandwidth (~7,500 MB/s max instead of 14,500 MB/s).
conditions_or_conflicts: Functional but speeds capped at PCIe 4.0 link rates (~50% of drive potential).

component_models: Samsung 970 Evo Plus 500GB (M.2 2280 NVMe Gen3), MSI MAG B650 Tomahawk WiFi
evidence_summary: PCIe 3.0 x4 M.2 2280 drive operates without restriction in any of the motherboard's PCIe 4.0 M.2 slots via standard PCIe backward compatibility.
conditions_or_conflicts: None.

component_models: Corsair RM750x (2024) 750W 80+ Gold, NVIDIA RTX 5070 (250W TGP)
evidence_summary: 750W capacity exceeds the 650W manufacturer recommended system PSU for RTX 5070. Corsair RM750x includes native ATX 3.1 12V-2x6 cable, delivering clean power without adapters.
conditions_or_conflicts: None.

component_models: Corsair RM750x (2024) 750W 80+ Gold, ASUS ROG Strix GeForce RTX 4090 24GB
evidence_summary: ASUS officially specifies a 1000W minimum system power supply for the ROG Strix RTX 4090 OC. Combined with a modern high-end CPU (e.g. i9-14900K or 9950X), transient power spikes (exceeding 600W on GPU alone) will trigger the 750W PSU's over-current protection (OCP), causing system shutdown.
conditions_or_conflicts: Capacity deficit: 750W is 250W below the 1000W manufacturer requirement.

component_models: Corsair HX1000i 1000W 80+ Platinum, ASUS ROG Strix GeForce RTX 4090 24GB
evidence_summary: 1000W Platinum PSU satisfies the exact 1000W manufacturer system requirement for ASUS ROG Strix RTX 4090 OC and provides high-amperage dedicated rails with native 12VHPWR support.
conditions_or_conflicts: None.

component_models: MSI MAG A550BN 550W 80+ Bronze, XFX Speedster SWFT 210 Radeon RX 6600 8GB
evidence_summary: XFX RX 6600 has 132W TBP and AMD recommends a 450W-550W system PSU. MSI MAG A550BN provides 550W on single +12V rail and includes two 6+2 pin PCIe power connectors (card requires one 8-pin).
conditions_or_conflicts: None.

component_models: MSI MAG A550BN 550W 80+ Bronze, ASUS RTX 4080 SUPER TUF GAMING OC 16GB
evidence_summary: ASUS RTX 4080 SUPER TUF Gaming OC specifies a minimum 750W system power supply. 550W is 200W below the required threshold and lacks native 12V-2x6 power delivery.
conditions_or_conflicts: Blocking electrical capacity conflict.

component_models: AMD Ryzen 9 5900X, Gigabyte B550 EAGLE WIFI6 (No Discrete GPU)
evidence_summary: AMD Ryzen 9 5900X does not contain an integrated graphics processor (iGPU). Motherboard HDMI/DisplayPort outputs require an APU. Without a discrete graphics card, the system cannot output display.
conditions_or_conflicts: Blocking operational conflict: discrete GPU required to produce video output.

component_models: AMD Ryzen 9 5900X, XFX Speedster SWFT 210 Radeon RX 6600 8GB
evidence_summary: Discrete GPU (XFX RX 6600) provides 3x DisplayPort 1.4 and 1x HDMI 2.1 display outputs, satisfying video output requirements for the non-iGPU CPU.
conditions_or_conflicts: Display monitor must be connected to GPU ports on back of chassis, not motherboard IO.

component_models: AMD Ryzen 5 9600X, MSI MAG B650 Tomahawk WiFi (No Discrete GPU)
evidence_summary: AMD Ryzen 5 9600X includes integrated AMD Radeon Graphics (2 CUs, RDNA 2 architecture). Motherboard HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4 outputs are fully functional for basic display output and general computing.
conditions_or_conflicts: Suitable for office/general use; inadequate for AAA 3D gaming.

component_models: Intel Core i7-14700F, MSI PRO H610M-G DDR4 (No Discrete GPU)
evidence_summary: Intel 'F' SKU processors (i7-14700F) have disabled integrated graphics silicon. Motherboard video ports will remain dark; discrete GPU is required for system boot and display.
conditions_or_conflicts: Blocking operational conflict: discrete GPU required.

component_models: G.Skill Trident Z5 Neo 32GB DDR5-6000 CL30, MSI B850 Edge WiFi, AMD Ryzen 5 9600X
evidence_summary: DDR5-6000 CL30 is AMD's official recommended 1:1 memory sweet spot for Zen 4 and Zen 5 processors. Supported with 1-click EXPO profile activation on B850 motherboard.
conditions_or_conflicts: Enable EXPO profile in UEFI BIOS.

component_models: Corsair Vengeance 32GB DDR5-6000 CL36, MSI MAG B650 Tomahawk WiFi, AMD Ryzen 5 9600X
evidence_summary: Kit uses Intel XMP profile. MSI motherboards support 'A-XMP' / 'i-EXPO' to translate XMP sub-timings to AMD memory controllers, but sub-timings may require manual tuning or slightly looser secondary timings than dedicated EXPO kits.
conditions_or_conflicts: Select XMP profile via MSI memory enhancement settings; verify stability with MemTest86.

component_models: Crucial MX500 2.5-inch SATA SSD, NZXT H7 Flow (2024)
evidence_summary: NZXT H7 Flow provides two dedicated 2.5-inch drive mounting trays behind the motherboard tray, allowing direct screw installation of the 2.5-inch SATA SSD.
conditions_or_conflicts: Requires standard SATA data cable connected to motherboard and SATA power cable from PSU.

component_models: Thermalright Peerless Assassin 120 SE, Corsair Vengeance RGB 192GB DDR5
evidence_summary: Corsair Vengeance RGB modules measure 44mm in height. Dual-tower air cooler (PA120 SE) has default RAM cutout clearance of ~35mm; the front 120mm fan must be unclipped and mounted 9mm higher on the fin stack.
conditions_or_conflicts: Front fan step-up increases total cooler height from 155mm to 164mm; requires chassis with at least 165mm cooler clearance.

component_models: NZXT H7 Flow (2024) Front Panel / Case Fans, MSI MAG B650 Tomahawk WiFi
evidence_summary: NZXT H7 Flow includes 3-pin/4-pin PWM fans. MSI B650 Tomahawk provides 6x 4-pin system fan headers, 1x CPU fan header, 1x pump fan header, and 2x 3-pin 5V ARGB headers, fully supporting the chassis cooling layout without an external hub.
conditions_or_conflicts: None; header count exceeds chassis fan requirements.

component_models: Cooler Master Hyper 212 Black (RR-S4KK-25SN-R1), Intel Core Ultra 9 285K (LGA1851)
evidence_summary: Cooler Master official technical documentation lists LGA1851 mounting support directly in product number RR-S4KK-25SN-R1 specifications. LGA1851 shares mechanical mounting hole spacing and Z-height with LGA1700.
conditions_or_conflicts: For 250W PL2 load on 285K, thermal throttling will occur under heavy AVX rendering; adequate for gaming.

component_models: ASUS ROG Strix RTX 4090 24GB (PCIe 4.0 x16, 3.5-slot), MSI MAG B650 Tomahawk WiFi
evidence_summary: Top PCIe 4.0 x16 slot on MSI B650 Tomahawk features Steel Armor reinforcement. However, the 3.5-slot thickness of the ROG Strix RTX 4090 physically covers the secondary PCIe x16 (x4 electrical) and PCIe x1 slots.
conditions_or_conflicts: Expansion card blockage: secondary PCIe slots cannot be utilized while 3.5-slot GPU is installed.

component_models: Corsair HX1000i 1000W 80+ Platinum (180mm length), Fractal Pop Air Mini
evidence_summary: Corsair HX1000i chassis depth is 180mm. Fractal Pop Air Mini specifies maximum PSU length of 150mm with the 3.5-inch drive cage installed, or up to 170mm with the cage shifted/removed. At 180mm + modular cable bends (~25mm), installation requires complete removal of the internal drive tray.
conditions_or_conflicts: Requires permanent removal of 3.5-inch internal drive cage; tight modular cable management space.
